extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures containing NH3 synthesis rate were Figure 1a,b and Figure 2. Figure 3 is an energy-profile schematic/analysis, Figure 4 reports MS ion currents for isotope products rather than NH3 synthesis rate/outlet NH3/TOF, and Figure 5 is a mechanism schematic; these were not digitised. Values are approximate reads from plotted bars/markers and are marked with qualifier '~'.
